newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 26.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on December 26:

WASHINGTON - The number of juveniles charged with narcotics-related crimes across the country has more than doubled since the beginning of the decade, even though the nation's overall crime rate continues to fall.
WASHINGTON - Anthony Williams, the District's generally soft-spoken chief financial officer, stands firm on budget cuts, gaining respect and power.
SARAJEVO - In a region obsessed with nationalism, identity and symbols, where everything from language to license plates is political, Santa Claus is no exception.
SPRINGFIELD, Mass. - For over a year, Shanda Barry has proudly worn the blue uniform of a Montgomery County police officer, but now she's traded it temporarily for a basketball jersey.

CHARLOTTE, N.C. - Leadres of eight major black denominations representing 65,000 churches resolved at a meeting of the Congress of National Black Churches this month to use their pulpits to push entrepreneurship.
